versions.name: Camp Illinek
versions.summary: Cub Scout resident camp near Chatham operated by the Abraham Lincoln Council, offering swimming at a local pool, archery, BB shooting, crafts, and outdoor programming.

sources.citation: coordinate geocoded from street address (US Census / OpenStreetMap), 2026-07-22

provenance.notes: Coordinate refined 2026-07-22 from the camp's street address (was a city/state-centroid approximation). Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/144-97467); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp.
